content.text: A feature that allows users to generate a personalized workout schedule based on their weekly availability and fitness goals.
The system shall allow users to select a frequency of 3, 4, or 5 workout days per week.
The system shall calculate and display projected effort and progress over a 3-month period.
The system shall generate a calendar view of the workouts once a frequency is selected.
Which weekly frequency (3, 4, or 5 days) best aligns with the user's progress goals and effort capacity?
